entries.note: Verified in recipe data: liquefaction makes 5 iron sulfur per iron ore (solvent: 10 mB sal ammoniac). Incubation: iron sulfur + mineral salt + mercury shard -> 1 iron ingot (100 ticks). So 1 ore yields 5 ingots. Reformation can also convert other common-metal sulfur/niter into iron sulfur. The same pattern exists per metal. Needs ore (Verdant: from sieving).
